podcasts.seoDescription: Listen to Max-Morrys's podcast: digital marketing strategies, SEO, AI and growth in Africa. Available on Spotify and Apple Podcasts.
podcasts.jsonLdDescription: Digital marketing strategies, SEO, AI and growth in Africa.
podcasts.heroText: Every week, new strategies, expert interviews and concrete advice to grow and scale your online business.
podcasts.behindMicText: I help organizations across French-speaking Africa grow — healthcare, services, education, social impact — by combining marketing strategy, data, content, partnerships, web development and process automation. The podcast is what I learn in the field, shared with no filter.
podcasts.subscribeText: A new episode every week, with guests and timely analysis. Pick your favorite platform and never miss a thing.
podcasts.episodesText: Straight-talking conversations to build a solid mindset, gain clarity and grow your business — episode after episode.
podcasts.clubText: On top of the podcast, I take part in and regularly host events. Club members are the first to know — and often the first invited.
podcasts.clubFeature1Text: Conferences, masterclasses and meetups — priority access and invitations reserved for Club members.
podcasts.clubFeature2Text: You'll always be the first to know about my upcoming appearances and the events you can't miss.
podcasts.videosCtaText: Practical videos on my channel to go even further, show the tools and take action.

pole.lede: No method, no tutorial — that's the blog. Here, people who really sell something in Dakar and Abidjan tell you what worked, and what cost them dearly.
pole.rhythm: One episode a month, when I have someone worth listening to. No calendar kept full for its own sake.
pole.truthBody: Each episode's and each video's weight should be written here — it's what lets you decide when your data plan is metered. It isn't measured at upload yet, and I'd rather tell you than announce a made-up number. No play counts either: with one episode, they'd say nothing useful.
pole.clubBody: The Club is where they are. Paid, closed, and it can't be toured — that's the price of keeping it closed.
pole.empty: Nothing's online here yet. The blog is open though — and everything on it is free.
pole.elsewhereBody: The videos are on YouTube too, and everything I publish goes out in the feed. If you're already subscribed there, keep your habits — I won't make you come back here to listen.
pole.elsewhereNote: Play counts are synced server-side, never called from your browser. They aren't shown here: on a single episode, a counter tells you nothing useful.
pole.elsewhereMissing: No Spotify page to give you yet: the podcast isn't published there under a feed of mine. The day it is, it shows up here.
